routes.name: Long-Term Resident (LTR) Visa: Wealthy Global Citizens
Long-Term Resident (LTR) Visa: Spouses and dependents

note: Thailand, read on 2026-10-31 on the Board of Investment's Long-Term Resident Visa site (ltr.boi.go.th): its home page, 'Visa Issuance' and 'Application Timeline'. The LTR visa has four types (Wealthy Global Citizen, Wealthy Pensioners, Work-from-Thailand Professionals, Highly skilled Professionals) and a dependants' visa for the spouse and children of a holder or applicant, each its own route here (Highly-skilled Professionals, working for business entities in targeted industries, written as talent; Work-from-Thailand, remote workers of overseas companies, as work). A grant is for five years at first and can be extended for five more if the qualifications are met (term five years, renewable; the site calls it a 10-year renewable visa). The visa is collected at the Thailand Investment and Expat Services Center in Bangkok or at a Royal Thai Embassy or Consulate-General overseas (apply: either). Its processing fee is 50,000 THB per person per 10 years in Thailand; overseas the fee may vary and is usually more, so the Thai fee is written. Work: the privileges include permission to work by a Digital Work Permit, which holders apply for for their employment (at 3,000 THB a year), so the right to work isn't written as given by the visa itself. The BOI's qualification endorsement takes about 20 business days once documents are complete, not a decision time the form holds as published, so no `within` is written. Not read: the Immigration Bureau's Non-Immigrant B visa with a work permit and extension of stay, and permanent residence (immigration.go.th answered with a Cloudflare check); they aren't written.

sources.title: Thailand Board of Investment, LTR Visa Thailand: Long Term Resident Program
sources.said: Permission will be granted to stay in Thailand the first time for five years which can be extended for 5 more years if qualifications are met. ... Permission to work in Thailand (Digital Work permit) ... There are four types of LTR visas designed to facilitate different types of individuals: Wealthy Global Citizen, Wealthy Pensioners, Work-from-Thailand Professionals, and Highly skilled Professionals. Spouse and children of LTR visa holder or applicants of any of the 4 types of visas are also eligible to apply for dependents’ visa. ... Remote workers working for well-established overseas companies

sources.title: Thailand Board of Investment, LTR Visa: Visa Issuance
sources.said: In case of LTR visa issuance at Thailand Investment and Expat Services Center (TIESC) in Bangkok ... In case of LTR visa issuance at Thai embassies or consulate generals overseas ... The LTR Visa processing fee of 50,000 THB per person per 10 years ... The total fee is calculated base on the annual fee of 3,000 THB per person per 1 year ... LTR visa processing fee at each Royal Thai Embassy/Consulate-General is based on the fee in Thailand (50,000 THB per person per 10 years), but may vary and is usually more than the fee in Thailand

sources.title: Thailand Board of Investment, LTR Visa: Application Timeline
sources.said: After LTR Visa issuance, LTR Visa holders are required to apply for a work permit for their employment in Thailand via LTR Visa application system.
